svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut the bought lid to 1,000 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Six slots 16 x 36 mm, 3 mm in from the edge that goes against

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the low wall, centred at 97.2, 291.6, 465 mm each side

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: of the centre line (the distillate tongue lines).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill a 6 mm hole at each slot corner and cut between with a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: sharp knife; deburr. No slot anywhere else: the brine tongues

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: pass 10.5 mm above the closed lid.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Clean with water and mild detergent only.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: snaps onto the channel; the bent distillate tongues go 3 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: down into the channel through the slots.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the lid is tight on the channel all along its length.
